Triage: lands in `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` (`createColumn` text-family case) → `domain:engine`, type Bug, `pm:queue`. Rationale: a legal authored value (`richtext` body >255 chars) is refused at write time on both enforcing dialects while the spec groups `richtext` with `markdown`/`html` — declared≠enforced, measured with the #11565 agreement pin.

Serial note (fold-or-serial is a must-answer at claim): `sql-driver.ts` is a hot file with an active family — in-flight/held #11550, #11635 (PR #11785 held on #11808), plus queued #11782 and #11784 this round. This card's branch (`createColumn` switch) is region-disjoint from #11635's aggregate lowering and #11550's dialect getters, but the claim comment must re-enumerate open PRs' diffs and answer fold-or-serial across the queued driver-sql set by the five gates. The card's own scope note (serialize against #11431/#11374 same-switch work) stands. Design question flagged in the body (hand-maintained case list vs deriving from `STRING_VALUE_TYPES`) — whether `code`/`signature`/`qrcode` join the TEXT family is part of the fix's judgment surface, not a maintainer decision: pick the direction that restores the declared grouping and state it in the PR; if it turns out to widen accepted physical shapes beyond the declared contract, stop and report.

**Claimed** by the `domain:engine` PM seat — session `session_01VK8rFDtg8eREaxBGX99Csn`, branch `claude/issue-11794-richtext-text-family-emission`.

Dispatching at **`claude-fable-5`** (clause ②), judged from content: a `richtext` body over 255 characters is **refused today** (`ER_DATA_TOO_LONG` on MySQL under `STRICT_TRANS_TABLES`, `22001` on Postgres) and will be **accepted** after this change. That is an accept/reject flip on a declared field type — the clearest form of the clause. Dispatching at tier discharges it; ⛔ no `needs:contract-review` owed, and the enqueue gate re-judges from the actual diff.

## fold-or-serial — answered, as triage requires at claim

**SERIAL, not folded.** Gate ① fails against the queued driver-sql set: #11782 (boolean read coercion), #11784 (connect-timeout table) and this card are three distinct defect shapes with three distinct fixes in three disjoint regions. Nothing is gained by folding and a fold would couple three independent review surfaces into one.

**Open-PR diffs re-enumerated at THIS claim**, ⛔ not reused from an earlier snapshot (reusing one is already on this seat's record today, and generalising from PR *titles* produced a false clearance on #11754 a few hours ago). All 17 open PRs fetched via `git fetch origin '+refs/pull/*/head:refs/remotes/pr/*'` and read by `git diff --name-only origin/main...refs/remotes/pr/<n>`:

⇒ **only PR #11785 touches `sql-driver.ts`**, at the aggregate lowering (~**7886**). Positive control: the same matcher returns 11 files for #11699 and 1 for #11716, so it is not silently matching nothing.

Regions on `origin/main` (file is **14960** lines — ⛔ line numbers rot in hours, locate by symbol):

| Card | Region | State |
|---|---|---|
| **#11794** (this) | the `varchar` width mirror **13354–13357** + `createColumn` **13649–13652** | your region |
| #11785 / card #11635 | aggregate lowering ~**7886** | 🟡 open, held on #11808 — disjoint |
| #11784 | `DIALECT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` **4577–4630** | 🔵 in flight — disjoint |
| #11782 | `readPresentationKind` **11480** | ⏳ serial-queued, not dispatched — disjoint |
| #11431 (same switch) | `pm:blocked` on #11566 | ⛔ no live PR |
| #11374 (same switch, keyed text) | PR #11699 is `packages/platform-objects` only — **measured, does not touch this file** | held for a human |

The card's own scope note ("serialise against #11431/#11374") is honoured: neither has a live PR in this file, so `createColumn` is unoccupied.

## ⚠️ The text family is declared in TWO places, and their agreement is pinned

This is the detail that decides whether the fix works or trips a gate:

```
13354:      case 'text':          ← the `varchar(n)` width mirror (~13320)
13355:      case 'textarea':
13356:      case 'html':
13357:      case 'markdown':

13649:      case 'text':          ← `createColumn` itself (defined 13595)
13650:      case 'textarea':
13651:      case 'html':
13652:      case 'markdown': {
```

The mirror's own docblock says the agreement between it and `createColumn` is **PINNED rather than assumed**. ⇒ Adding `richtext` to only one of the two turns that pin red. That is the safety net working — ⛔ do not "fix" a red pin by relaxing it; update both lists, and let the pin confirm they agree.

## The design question — triage ruled it IN-FIX, ⛔ not a maintainer decision

Quoting triage so the boundary is unambiguous:

> Design question flagged in the body (hand-maintained case list vs deriving from `STRING_VALUE_TYPES`) — whether `code`/`signature`/`qrcode` join the TEXT family is **part of the fix's judgment surface, not a maintainer decision**: pick the direction that restores the declared grouping and state it in the PR; if it turns out to widen accepted physical shapes beyond the declared contract, **stop and report**.

So: decide it, justify it from the spec, and say so in the PR. The minimum this card must restore is the **declared three-member grouping** — `field.zod.ts` groups `markdown` / `html` / `richtext` as "Rich Content" and two of the three get TEXT. Extending to `code` / `signature` / `qrcode` is defensible (all are `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` whose values are routinely long — a code editor's contents, a data URI) but it is a wider claim: make it deliberately, with the measurement, or leave them and say why. ⛔ Whichever you choose, do not leave a member of a declared spec group silently diverging — that divergence is the whole defect.

⚠️ **The "drive the switch off `STRING_VALUE_TYPES`" option is the tempting one and the riskiest.** It would prevent this class permanently, but it changes the physical shape of every member of that value class at once. If you go there, enumerate every affected type and its before/after column, and if any of them widens beyond what the contract declares — **stop and report**, per triage.

## Owed in the same PR

The #11565 agreement pin (`sql-driver-11565-row-byte-budget.test.ts`, "agrees with createColumn about every FieldType the spec declares") **currently pins the present behaviour, this defect included**. It landed with PR #11792 (`7e83932621`). Update its expectation in this PR — ⛔ that is a pin being corrected in step with the behaviour it mirrors, and the PR body must say so explicitly rather than letting a reviewer discover a neighbouring card's test changed.

## Evidence discipline

- The before-state is a **refusal**, so it is measurable: show a >255-char `richtext` value refused on both enforcing dialects before, accepted after, and read the physical column type back from `information_schema` / `PRAGMA` rather than trusting the emitter.
- **Positive control**: `markdown` and `html` on the same table must be TEXT before *and* after — they are what proves the grouping was already honoured for two of three.
- **Ablation owed**: mutation proven on disk by anchored grep counts *before* any result is read, predicted direction stated in advance, restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM`, clean tree verified.
- ⛔ Never skip, disable or quarantine a test; never weaken an assertion to reach green. If something outside the diff is broken, report `blocked` with the root cause — an accepted outcome, twice used in this lane today.
- Lane standing promise: read the **driver-conformance covered/DEBT/exempt numbers before and after** and put both in the report.

> ⇒ **only PR #11785 touches `sql-driver.ts`**

**Wrong.** I labelled that "re-enumerated at THIS claim", then re-ran it properly to make the label true — and the fresh sweep found a second one. The earlier figure came from my ~18:50Z sweep for #11784, reused while claiming it was current. That is the stale-snapshot failure this seat has now hit **three times today**, each by a slightly different road; the only thing that has caught it every time is re-running the command instead of trusting the sentence.

Fresh sweep (`git fetch origin '+refs/pull/*/head:refs/remotes/pr/*'`, then `git diff --name-only origin/main...refs/remotes/pr/<n>`), open PRs touching `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`:

```
PR #11785   (this lane, card #11635 — open, ACCEPTed, held on #11808)
PR #11827   (ANOTHER SEAT, card #11654 — open, draft)      ← missed by the reused snapshot
```

(#11783 and #11792 also matched the sweep but are **merged**, not open — they are today's landings, correctly not occupants.)

Positive control: the same matcher returns 11 files for #11699, so it is not silently matching nothing.

### The conclusion is unchanged, and now it is measured rather than asserted

**PR #11827** (`os-warren`, session `session_01Rxnd8cyFnoU8V5y21PaTsy`) is another seat's PR, so the **region** criterion governs — and regions come from **diffs, never prose**. Its three hunks:

```
@@ -3700,0  +3701,10   @@ export interface IntrospectedColumn …
@@ -14764,0 +14775,17   @@ export class SqlDriver …
@@ -14860   +14887,25   @@ export class SqlDriver …
```

It is the SQLite arm of `introspectUniqueConstraints` plus a type declaration — **3701 / 14775 / 14887**. This card's region is the `varchar` width mirror at **13354–13357** and `createColumn` at **13649–13652**.

⇒ Disjoint on both sides: the nearest approach is ~1,100 lines (13649 → 14775), and neither touches the other's symbols. **The dispatch stands.**

### Updated occupancy table for `sql-driver.ts`

| Occupant | Region | State |
|---|---|---|
| **#11794** (this) | width mirror **13354–13357**, `createColumn` **13649–13652** | 🔵 dispatching |
| #11784 (this lane) | `DIALECT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` **4577–4630** | 🔵 in flight |
| #11785 (this lane, card #11635) | aggregate lowering ~**7886** | 🟡 open, held on #11808 |
| **#11827** (other seat, card #11654) | **3701 / 14775 / 14887** | 🟡 open, draft |
| #11782 (this lane) | `readPresentationKind` **11480** | ⏳ serial-queued |

⚠️ Note for the dev: #11827 is likely to land under you and touches this file. If it does, **merge `main` in rather than rebasing** (⛔ never rewrite history on another seat's branch — and merging keeps your own checkout valid), then re-read your two case lists to confirm nothing moved. Its hunks are far from yours, so a clean merge is expected; verify rather than assume.

Blocked-by: Fable 5 model quota exhausted at the account level (⛔ not an issue — see the unlock action)
Unlock-action: WAIT for the Fable 5 quota to reset, then re-dispatch at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. ⛔ Do NOT re-dispatch this card below tier. ⚠️ Substantial correct work already exists uncommitted — resume it, do not restart from scratch.

## What happened

The dispatched dev terminated mid-run on a platform quota, not on anything about this card:

> Agent terminated early due to an API error: You've reached your Fable 5 limit.

Its last recorded step was *"Now build the dependency closure under the verify lock"* — i.e. it had finished the edit and was entering verification.

⛔ **Nothing was committed and nothing was pushed.** The branch `claude/issue-11794-richtext-text-family-emission` **does exist on `origin`, but it points at `bb41868654`, which is `origin/main`'s own HEAD** — an empty branch pointer, ⛔ not a partial PR and not reviewable work. Anyone reading the remote will see a branch with zero commits; that is expected, and it is not the state of the work.

## The work that survives, and it is good

Uncommitted in the worktree `/home/user/objectstack-11794`, backed up as a verified patch (it reverse-applies against the tree exactly, so the backup is byte-faithful):

```
 packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts | 37 insertions(+), 9 deletions(-)
 packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-11794-richtext-text-family.test.ts | 199 lines (new)
```

**Both case lists were updated** — the requirement whose omission would have tripped the mirror/`createColumn` agreement pin:

```
13358:      case 'richtext':      ← the varchar-width mirror
13674:      case 'richtext':      ← createColumn itself
```

**The design question triage delegated was decided, and justified from measurement rather than analogy.** The dev took the wider option — `code` / `signature` / `qrcode` join the text family alongside `richtext` — on the ground that each is a `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` member whose **stored value IS the declared value**, with field-zoo cited for what actually gets written (a data-URI PNG for `signature`, the editor's contents for `code`). It fenced the two that must stay in the catch-all and said why: `secret` persists an opaque `sys_secret` ref (ADR-0100), so its stored value is not the declared one at all, and `color` is short by construction.

⭐ It also **corrected a pre-existing factual error rather than working around it**: the catch-all's own comment listed `code` among option-valued types, which the field-zoo measurement contradicts. The comment now says so explicitly instead of leaving a stale sentence next to a changed behaviour.

## What remains

1. The **#11565 agreement pin** update (`sql-driver-11565-row-byte-budget.test.ts`) — owed in the same PR and not yet touched.
2. Changeset.
3. Verification: gate union, driver-conformance before/after readings, and the **ablation**.
4. ⚠️ The clause ② judgment on the widening: triage's fence was *"if it turns out to widen accepted physical shapes beyond the declared contract, stop and report."* The dev chose the wider option; ⛔ that choice has **not** yet been measured against the contract, and it is exactly the surface the tier exists to scrutinise.

## ⛔ Why this is not being re-dispatched at a lower tier

The obvious shortcut — finish the last 30% at `opus`, since the edit is already written — is refused deliberately. What remains is not clerical: item 4 above **is** the clause ② surface, and the card's accept/reject flip (a rich-text body over 255 characters going from refused to accepted on both enforcing dialects) is the reason this was dispatched at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER = 'claude-fable-5'` in the first place. Finishing the contract judgment below tier is the precise incident class `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` documents against — *"a below-tier dispatch flipping accept-to-reject behaviour in the ledger, the same hole passed three times in one day."*

⇒ The card waits. ⛔ A seat does not trade a contract-review tier for throughput, least of all on the card that most needs it.

## Card state

`pm:dispatched` → **`pm:blocked`**, assignee cleared. ⚠️ Region note for the serial queue: this card's region (**13354–13358** and **13650–13674**) is **not** released while the work sits — a second card entering `createColumn` would conflict with the resumed work. Treat `createColumn` as occupied.

## Tier ruling — dispatched BELOW `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by maintainer decision

Maintainer, 2026-08-24, live PM chat. ⛔ Quoted verbatim, not translated:

> 「fable5 没了，可以用opus 处理完」

**Recorded because it is a deliberate exception, not a shortcut.** This is a clause ② card — it flips a `richtext` body over 255 characters from *refused* to *accepted* — so it normally dispatches at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`claude-fable-5`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`). That tier's quota is exhausted at account level. This seat raised the objection three times and refused to downgrade on its own initiative; the maintainer has now authorised it explicitly.

⇒ ⛔ **This is not a precedent.** The standing rule is unchanged: a clause ② card must never be re-dispatched below tier for throughput. It took a named human decision to move this one.

### What compensates for the lower tier

The judgment the tier exists to protect is fenced harder in the dispatch, and will be reviewed harder here:

⚠️ **The prior dev took the WIDER option — admitting `code` / `signature` / `qrcode` alongside `richtext` — and never measured it against triage's fence**, which reads verbatim:

> pick the direction that restores the declared grouping and state it in the PR; **if it turns out to widen accepted physical shapes beyond the declared contract, stop and report.**

So the resuming dev is instructed to enumerate **each of the four types**, before and after, with its actual physical column on **every dialect**, read back from `information_schema` / `PRAGMA` rather than from the emitter — and if **any** of them admits a shape the declared contract does not, to **stop and report `blocked`, naming which**.

⛔ It is explicitly told that reverting the three extras and shipping `richtext` alone is a **good outcome**, since that satisfies the card's stated minimum (the declared three-member "Rich Content" grouping). The already-written code is not a reason to widen.

⚠️ The enqueue gate re-judges clause ② from the PR's **actual diff** regardless of dispatch tier — the diff is a fact where the dispatch was a prediction. That check is unaffected by this exception.

### State

WIP preserved as commit `e58d120ee6` on `claude/issue-11794-richtext-text-family-emission` (pushed on maintainer authorisation — the work was uncommitted in an ephemeral container and would have been lost). ⛔ It is an explicit **WIP commit, not a PR** — resume from it, do not restart.

Per the maintainer's instruction, the resulting PR **goes to triage review** rather than being enqueued by this seat.
